action_items: None — pyramid endgame feature is production-ready on the frontend. All 7 review-request flows verified against world_1 in OPEN state with a 22.0k neutral Guardian.

INFO: The map-pyramid-card stays mounted underneath the /pyramid stack screen, so pyramid-attack-button count is 2 on /pyramid — the review-request note documents this. Consumers should use a scoped locator ([data-testid="pyramid-hero"] [data-testid="pyramid-attack-button"]) or .first when scripting.

OPTIONAL nit: alliance-pyramid-tile is rendered for MERCENARY leaders too (rival sees the tile with Dettagli button and correctly gets pyramid-not-eligible on the details screen). If MERCENARY alliances should not see the tile at all, hide alliance-pyramid-tile when the alliance is MERCENARY — current behavior is arguably more informative (they see 'Esclusa dalla Piramide' badge on alliance-summary), so keeping it is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: PyramidCard.tsx (/app/frontend/src/components/PyramidCard.tsx:99-108) correctly renders pyramid-details-button, and conditionally pyramid-attack-button / pyramid-reinforce-button based on me.can_attack / me.can_reinforce from the DTO. Non-eligible users get pyramid-not-eligible hint, non-OPEN state gets pyramid-not-open hint — mutually exclusive, no dead-code paths.

pyramid.tsx (/app/frontend/app/pyramid.tsx:35-300) uses a single Panel per section with clear testIDs (pyramid-hero, -garrison, -rewards, -cycle, -battles, -history) and safe-area insets — vertical scroll works cleanly on 390x844.

map.tsx (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/map.tsx:119-120) map-center-pyramid-button anchors on pyramid.data?.anchor with a fallback to (200,200) — no null-crash if API is late; icon color switches to brandPrimary when state==='OPEN' (nice visual affordance).

AllianceSummary.tsx (/app/frontend/src/components/alliance/AllianceSummary.tsx:161-176) renders alliance-pyramid-tile with description + phase + Dettagli button. Consider hiding when alliance.type==='MERCENARY' since the ineligibility is already shown via 'Esclusa dalla Piramide' badge — minor UX polish, not a bug.

inbox.tsx (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/inbox.tsx:114-125) PYRAMID_STATE_CHANGED payload renders as 'pyramid · <state> · [owner_tag]? · <deadline>?'; deep-link starting with 'pyramid' routes to /pyramid — matched behavior in test.

rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration. All 7 mandatory review-request flows verified with clean testIDs and correct Italian strings. One transient page.goto timeout when trying to bounce back to '/' for logout was mitigated by opening a fresh browser context (the /pyramid stack + expo router + WebGL canvas can be slow to unload); switching contexts is the recommended logout approach for future scripts. Two Playwright TouchAction/visibility errors mid-run happened when a stack modal (/march/new, /pyramid) was still occluding the tab bar — solved by tapping pyramid-back or going back before switching tabs, or by using a fresh page context. Neither is a product bug.
